beginner: shape, value, color, light, material, and composition vocabulary
senior: protects hierarchy and authored identity across disciplines
balances artistic intent with runtime and pipeline constraints
recognizes genericness and weak reference transfer
lead_director: sets canon, selection criteria, review cadence, and tradeoffs
knows when to reject production and return to visual development

failure_patterns.repair: restore value separation with motivated fill, exposure control, surface response, and readable background structure
design environment around subject purpose, landmarks, scale cues, and narrative function
derive effect shape, timing, density, and color from the visual thesis and gameplay/scene purpose

symptoms: valid mesh/material but weak silhouette and light response
failure_patterns.repair: return to silhouette, proportion, value, and controlled neutral/grazing/production renders

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
transfers: evidence discipline and testable criteria are analogous to separating objective and subjective claims

transfers: version-specific color-management reference; revalidate when Blender changes

known_limits: No script can certify taste, originality, emotion, or professional appeal.
Existing Blender and Unreal operations prove infrastructure and bounded production tasks, not broad art mastery.
